name: Vanilla
source:
Feline species: Mix

Youngest catgirl of the Minazuki family and [url=/c20880]Chocola's[/url] twin sister. She follows Chocola wherever she goes.

She is one of [url=/s2302]Sayori's[/url] personal mascot characters.
